lenses.label: Horálek optical
lenses.title: Petr Horálek’s wide-field SMC
lenses.description: Optical photograph colours are painted onto the shared image-fitted SMC emission model. Depth follows the VMC-constrained ellipsoid envelope and conditional simulation modes, not measured gas or dust. Catalogue-star positions are observed; their modeled depths do not establish individual distances. The reference image shows the photograph before star removal and 3D emission fitting.
lenses.summary: Optical photograph colours on an image-fitted emission model; gas and dust depth are not measured.
